# Fixtures

These JSON files are recorded responses from the GTA Wiki MediaWiki API
(`https://gta.fandom.com/api.php`) and the English Wikipedia API
(`https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php`). Tests replay them so they do not hit
the network.

The wiki text inside them is CC BY-SA. Fandom community text:
<https://www.fandom.com/licensing>. Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0:
<https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/>.

They are not a content mirror. The server fetches live pages when a tool runs.
Attribute the source page when you reuse the text.
